qa_pairs.question: What engine designations are listed at the bottom of this page?
qa_pairs.answer: BMW 320 is - Engine S 14 B 20 and BMW M 3 - Engine S 14 B 23 are listed at the bottom of the page.

qa_pairs.question: What text is visible on the engine valve cover in the illustration?
qa_pairs.answer: The valve cover displays 'BMW M Power' text on top of the engine.

qa_pairs.question: What major engine components are visible in this cutaway illustration?
qa_pairs.answer: The illustration shows the cylinder head with valve cover, engine block with pistons and cylinders, crankcase, oil pan, exhaust manifold, intake manifold, and cooling system components.

qa_pairs.question: How is the engine oriented in this illustration?
qa_pairs.answer: The engine is shown at an angle that displays the front and one side, providing a three-dimensional perspective of the complete assembly.

qa_pairs.question: What can you see of the internal engine components in this cutaway view?
qa_pairs.answer: The cutaway view reveals the pistons, connecting rods, crankshaft, valvetrain components, and internal passages within the engine block and cylinder head.

qa_pairs.question: What external accessories and components are visible on the engine?
qa_pairs.answer: External components visible include the alternator, various hoses and lines, the exhaust manifold, intake manifold, and what appears to be engine mounting points.
